summary.en: One thread gathers a scattered pile: from the mascot its white-hot head runs one smooth path through the centre of every item (each lights with a ring as it is pierced), then the whole thread goes taut once and relaxes.
summary.zh: 一根线收拢散乱的一堆：线头从吉祥物出发，沿一条平滑路径穿过每件东西的中心（被穿过的亮一圈），然后整根线绷紧一次再放松。

fits: Turning a pile of loose things into one connected thing; the hook's peak.
notFor: Items that must be read while it runs; fewer than four items.

intent.en: Show one attention taking every loose thing at once.
intent.zh: 让人看到一个注意力一次接住了所有散乱的东西。

content.en: Nothing to read: the items' rectangles and the thread's start.
content.zh: 没有字：各件东西的位置和线的起点。

fits.zh: 把一堆散乱的东西变成连着的一串；开场的高峰。

notFor.zh: 穿的时候要读的东西；少于四件。

en: Order the items by angle round the start, not by layer: a path by layer zig-zags and reads as random.
The taut swell is the beat's hit: land it on a downbeat.
zh: 按绕起点的角度排序，不按层级：按层级走的路径来回折，看起来像乱的。
绷紧那一下是节拍重音：落在强拍上。

source.path: assets/templates/stream/plan.js (the opening's path: Catmull-Rom by angle, io2 over 3.5 beats, pierce times); film.js renderOpen

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
